name: Simply Popups – Popup, Modal, Lead Gen
author: Strategy11 Team

sections.description:
Simply Popups is a lightweight and intuitive WordPress plugin that empowers you to create beautiful and effective modal popups with ease. Engage your audience, highlight important content, and drive conversions by presenting custom messages, forms, or offers in a non-intrusive popup window.

Key Features (Free Version):

Effortless Creation: Design and customize popups directly within the WordPress editor using your own content.
Button Click Trigger: Display popups when users click on a designated button or element on your page.
Fully Customizable Content: Use the standard WordPress editor to add text, images, videos, shortcodes, and more to your popups.
Responsive Design: Popups are automatically responsive and look great on all devices.
*Simple & Clean Interface: Get started quickly with a user-friendly administration area.

Upgrade to Simply Popups Pro

Unlock even more powerful features and take your popups to the next level with Simply Popups Pro!

Pro Features Include:

Multiple Trigger Options:
Link Click: Trigger popups when users click on any designated link.
Image Click: Display popups when specific images are clicked.
Page Load: Automatically show popups after a set delay when a page loads.
Exit Intent: Capture abandoning visitors by displaying a popup just as they are about to leave your site.
Priority Support: Get faster assistance from our dedicated support team.

Visit SimplyPopups.com to learn more and upgrade to Simply Popups Pro!

Support

If you have any questions, bug reports, or feature requests, please use the WordPress.org support forums for this plugin. We do our best to respond to all inquiries. For Pro version support, please use the dedicated support channel provided after purchase.

Developed with ❤️ for the WordPress Community by Strategy 11
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simply-popups directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to any WordPress page in Gutenberg to start creating your first popup.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I create a new popup?
A: Choose the “Simply Popups” block inside of the Gutenberg editor. That’s it! Then you’re free to customize both the button trigger and your model content.

Q: Is the plugin responsive?
A: Yes, all popups created with Simply Popups are fully responsive and will adapt to different screen sizes.

Q: Can I use shortcodes inside my popups?
A: Absolutely! Simply Popups fully supports WordPress shortcodes, allowing you to embed forms, galleries, and more.
